name: Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells flour products in Japan. The company offers wheat, bread, noodle, pasta, bran, mixed, alps, whole meal, and rye flour; and powders, hotcake high mix, and commercial frozen dough. It is also involved in warehousing business for storing wheat. In addition, the company operates fast food restaurants, such as KFC franchisee in the Kanto and Tokai regions. The company was incorporated in 1914 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation.
